tables.name: device_authorization
tables.description: FDA premarket decisions for devices, one row per authorization, as openFDA lists them

columns.name: authorization_id
columns.description: FDA premarket number, for example K200667

columns.name: applicant_name
columns.description: Company that applied, as FDA spells it

columns.name: device_name
columns.description: Device name in the FDA record

columns.name: product_code
columns.description: FDA product code

columns.name: authorized_on
columns.description: Date FDA made the decision

columns.name: authorization_pathway
columns.description: Pathway as openFDA names it, for example Traditional or Direct

tables.name: device_version_record
tables.description: Software versions FDA lists for an authorization, one row per public device record

columns.name: device_record_key
columns.description: Public device record key from the FDA device identifier database

columns.name: authorization_id
columns.description: Authorization the record is filed under

columns.name: brand_name
columns.description: Brand name on the record

columns.name: listed_version
columns.description: Version or model number the record lists. A claim about another version is not covered by this record

columns.name: version_published_on

tables.name: registered_study
tables.description: Clinical studies from the ClinicalTrials.gov snapshot, one row per registered study

columns.name: study_id
columns.description: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, for example NCT03112005

columns.name: title
columns.description: Brief title

columns.name: status
columns.description: Overall status as the registry reports it

columns.name: study_started
columns.description: Start date as written. Partial dates such as 2005-05 stay text

columns.name: study_enrolled
columns.description: Participants enrolled, as the registry reports the count

columns.name: study_enrolled_age_min_years
columns.description: Youngest age the eligibility criteria admit, in years. Empty when the record has no eligibility block. Empty is unknown, never zero

columns.name: record_kind
columns.description: full_record, or search_summary when the record came from a search result and carries no eligibility block

tables.name: vendor_claim
tables.description: Claims in vendor evidence packets, one row per claim. Commercial columns of the packet export are left out on purpose

columns.name: packet_id

columns.name: cited_authorization

columns.name: claimed_version

columns.name: claimed_age_min_years

columns.name: claimed_setting
columns.description: Care setting or settings the claim covers, separated by a vertical bar

columns.name: claimed_purpose
columns.description: Intended purpose the claim states

columns.name: claimed_equipment
columns.description: Equipment the claim covers, for example a camera model

tables.name: review_case

columns.name: case_id

columns.name: submission_id

columns.name: vendor_name
columns.description: Vendor name in the hospital record

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: Product under review

columns.name: product_version_claimed

columns.name: packet_id

columns.name: cited_authorization
columns.description: FDA premarket number the submission cites

columns.name: intended_purpose

columns.name: intended_setting

columns.name: intended_age_min_years

columns.name: deployment_date

tables.description: What the hospital asks of a product for an intended purpose, one row per requirement. Constructed data

columns.name: applies_to_purpose

columns.name: dimension

columns.name: required_value

columns.name: policy_ref

columns.name: effective_on

tables.name: confirmed_evidence_link
tables.description: Links a reviewer made between a case and a public record, with the class the reviewer gave them

columns.name: link_id
columns.description: Link identifier

columns.name: case_id
columns.description: Case the link belongs to

columns.name: left_type
columns.description: Kind of record on the left, for example fda_submission

columns.name: left_id

columns.name: right_type

columns.name: right_id

columns.name: link_class

tables.name: case_evidence_matrix
tables.description: The three silos joined once per case and claim, so a consumer reads one table. Same logic as the Evidence Matrix statement

columns.name: matrix_key
columns.description: Case and claim, joined by a vertical bar

columns.name: case_id
columns.description: Hospital case

columns.name: claim_id
columns.description: Vendor claim on the case packet

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: Product under review

columns.name: authorization_id
columns.description: FDA premarket number the submission cites

columns.name: listed_versions
columns.description: Versions FDA lists for that authorization, separated by a vertical bar

columns.name: claimed_version
columns.description: Version the claim is about

columns.name: claimed_age_min_years
columns.description: Lowest age in years the claim covers

columns.name: intended_age_min_years
columns.description: Youngest age in years the hospital intends to use it for

columns.name: confirmed_studies
columns.description: Studies a reviewer confirmed for the case

columns.name: study_enrolled_age_min_years
columns.description: Youngest age enrolled across the confirmed studies. Empty is unknown, never zero

columns.name: version_listed
columns.description: LISTED when the claimed version is among the listed versions, otherwise NOT_LISTED

columns.name: claim_age_vs_study
columns.description: CLAIM_BELOW_STUDY_MINIMUM when the claim reaches younger patients than the study enrolled, WITHIN_STUDY, or UNKNOWN

columns.name: case_age_vs_study
columns.description: NOT_COVERED_BY_STUDY when the hospital intends younger patients than the study enrolled, COVERED_BY_STUDY, or UNKNOWN

tables.name: collection_manifest
tables.description: One row per landed collection. expected_total is what landing recorded, retrieved_total is counted live, a short collection fails the completeness rule

columns.name: collection_id
columns.description: Database and table of the collection, for example sk_registry.ctgov_studies

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Source the collection was landed from

columns.name: expected_total
columns.description: Records the source or the landing step said the collection holds. Empty means nobody said, which is unknown

columns.name: retrieved_total
columns.description: Records counted now in the silo table. Empty means the layer cannot count the collection

columns.name: truncated
columns.description: True when the connector reported that it stopped early

columns.name: landed_sha256
columns.description: Hash of the file that was landed

tables.name: term_definition
tables.description: The words the compiler reasons with, care settings and intended purposes and metrics, with where each sits and what it means

columns.name: term_id
columns.description: Kind and word, joined by a colon

columns.name: kind
columns.description: setting, purpose, metric or population

columns.name: term
columns.description: The word as a source writes it

columns.name: canonical_term
columns.description: The node or metric the compiler reads that word as

columns.name: is_alias
columns.description: True when the word is a spelling of another term

columns.name: label
columns.description: Plain label

columns.name: broader_term
columns.description: The next broader term, for settings and purposes

columns.name: ancestry
columns.description: Path from the broadest term to this one, separated by a vertical bar

columns.name: depth
columns.description: Steps below the broadest term. 0 is the broadest

columns.name: definition
columns.description: What the term means and what evidence established for it covers

columns.name: unit
columns.description: proportion for a rate from 0 to 1, years for an age

columns.name: value_min
columns.description: Lowest value the unit allows

columns.name: value_max
columns.description: Highest value the unit allows

columns.name: prevalence_dependent
columns.description: True when the value changes with how common the condition is in the people tested

columns.name: origin
columns.description: Where the row comes from, taxonomy and version

definitions.label: area under the ROC curve
definitions.definition: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, from 0 to 1, where 0.5 is no better than chance. It summarises every threshold, so it does not state the operating point a product runs at.

definitions.label: negative predictive value
definitions.definition: Share of unflagged people who do not have the target condition, as a proportion from 0 to 1. It depends on how common the condition is in the people tested, so a value measured in one population does not carry to a population with another prevalence.

definitions.label: positive predictive value
definitions.definition: Share of flagged people who have the target condition, as a proportion from 0 to 1. It depends on how common the condition is in the people tested, so a value measured in one population does not carry to a population with another prevalence.

definitions.label: sensitivity (true positive rate)
definitions.definition: Share of people who have the target condition that the product flags, as a proportion from 0 to 1, so 0.85 means 85 percent. Recall and true positive rate are the same quantity.

definitions.label: specificity (true negative rate)
definitions.definition: Share of people without the target condition that the product leaves unflagged, as a proportion from 0 to 1. True negative rate is the same quantity.

definitions.label: adult
definitions.definition: A word, not an age. Sources define it differently, so this layer holds no number for it. Compare the lower age bound each source states: study_enrolled_age_min_years for a study, claimed_age_min_years for a vendor claim, intended_age_min_years for a hospital case. A bound that is not stated is unknown and is never read as zero or as everyone.

definitions.label: image acquisition guidance
definitions.definition: image acquisition guidance. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.

definitions.label: diagnosis
definitions.definition: diagnosis. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the purposes inside it (detection aid, triage notification).

definitions.label: monitoring
definitions.definition: monitoring. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.

definitions.label: prognosis or risk prediction
definitions.definition: prognosis or risk prediction. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.

definitions.label: screening of an unselected population
definitions.definition: screening of an unselected population. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.

definitions.label: treatment planning
definitions.definition: treatment planning. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.

definitions.label: detection aid
definitions.definition: detection aid. Sits inside diagnosis. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the purposes inside it (triage notification). It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.

definitions.label: triage notification
definitions.definition: triage notification. Sits inside detection aid, diagnosis. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: any care setting
definitions.definition: any care setting. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the settings inside it (hospital (any unit), emergency department, inpatient ward, intensive care unit, outpatient care (any clinic), primary care, urgent care, specialty clinic, eye care, imaging centre, home or remote care).

definitions.label: home or remote care
definitions.definition: home or remote care. Sits inside any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.

definitions.label: hospital (any unit)
definitions.definition: hospital (any unit). Sits inside any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the settings inside it (emergency department, inpatient ward, intensive care unit). It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.

definitions.label: outpatient care (any clinic)
definitions.definition: outpatient care (any clinic). Sits inside any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the settings inside it (primary care, urgent care, specialty clinic, eye care, imaging centre). It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.

definitions.label: emergency department
definitions.definition: emergency department. Sits inside hospital (any unit), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: imaging centre
definitions.definition: imaging centre. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: inpatient ward
definitions.definition: inpatient ward. Sits inside hospital (any unit), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: intensive care unit
definitions.definition: intensive care unit. Sits inside hospital (any unit), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: primary care
definitions.definition: primary care. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: specialty clinic
definitions.definition: specialty clinic. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the settings inside it (eye care). It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: urgent care
definitions.definition: urgent care. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

definitions.label: eye care
definitions.definition: eye care. Sits inside specialty clinic, outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

dqRules.description: A landed collection is complete only when its expected size is known, the whole of it is present, and the connector did not report stopping early
dqRules.expression: expected_total IS NOT NULL AND retrieved_total IS NOT NULL AND retrieved_total >= expected_total AND truncated = FALSE
dqRules.consequence: A collection that fails feeds nothing downstream: its records are not used as evidence, and the finding that needed them is unresolved, not negative.

dqRules.description: A study record must carry an eligibility block, or its youngest enrolled age is unknown
dqRules.consequence: A study that fails cannot answer an age question. Unknown is never read as covered.

dqRules.description: A device record must state the version it lists
dqRules.expression: listed_version IS NOT NULL AND listed_version <> ''
dqRules.consequence: A record without a version cannot show that a claimed version is covered.

dqRules.description: A claim must state a lowest age between 0 and 120 years
dqRules.expression: claimed_age_min_years IS NOT NULL AND claimed_age_min_years BETWEEN 0 AND 120
dqRules.consequence: A claim with an impossible or missing age is held for a reviewer instead of being compared.

dqRules.description: A claim must cite the FDA premarket number it relies on
dqRules.expression: cited_authorization IS NOT NULL AND cited_authorization <> ''
dqRules.consequence: A claim that cites nothing has no regulator record to be checked against.

dqRules.description: A case must name its setting and purpose with words the term table defines
dqRules.consequence: A case in an unknown word cannot be placed on the hierarchy; it goes to a reviewer instead of being guessed.

dqRules.description: A metric defined as a proportion must be bounded by 0 and 1
dqRules.expression: unit IS NULL OR unit <> 'proportion' OR (value_min IS NOT NULL AND value_max IS NOT NULL AND value_min >= 0 AND value_max <= 1)
dqRules.consequence: A rate outside 0 to 1 would be read as a percentage by mistake.

statements.statement: SELECT 'device_authorization' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.device_authorization UNION ALL SELECT 'device_version_record' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.device_version_record UNION ALL SELECT 'registered_study' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.registered_study UNION ALL SELECT 'vendor_claim' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.vendor_claim UNION ALL SELECT 'review_case' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.review_case UNION ALL SELECT 'hospital_requirement' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.hospital_requirement UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_evidence_link' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.confirmed_evidence_link UNION ALL SELECT 'case_evidence_matrix' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.case_evidence_matrix UNION ALL SELECT 'collection_manifest' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.collection_manifest UNION ALL SELECT 'term_definition' AS table_name, count(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.term_definition
SELECT collection_id, source_id, expected_total, retrieved_total, truncated FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.collection_manifest ORDER BY collection_id

SELECT d.kind, d.term, d.canonical_term, d.is_alias, d.label, d.broader_term, d.ancestry, d.depth, d.definition, d.unit, d.value_min, d.value_max, d.prevalence_dependent, d.origin FROM lightning.metastore.sakaime.review_semantics.term_definition d WHERE d.is_alias = FALSE ORDER BY d.kind, d.depth, d.term
